Lot 1 Amy Johnson Highway, Rainbow, Area of mallee and Yellow Gum woodland vegetation between Birdcage Flora Fauna Reserve Weddings (Buloke/Black Box). The attraction here is Wimmera community that poorly represented in nearby reserves. Deep sand dune systems occur at southern end property. This a private conservation property, but birders are more than welcome. Access either from south along off Rainbow-Nhill Road, or via Road. An entrance gate on northern boundary. For further info, contact Chris Lindorff 0437 952 421 chrisl@tfn.org.au
